evidence.C1: Strong field-guide touches like 'numbered plates I and II' and a glass-box tank, but some screens still read as standard white cards.
evidence.C2: Clear prompts such as 'Tap a fish to meet it, or tap the glass.' and 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast', though the phone tool grid is somewhat crowded.
evidence.C3: Feature summary lists many interlocking loops: 'Breeding with inherited colours', 'Greenhouse trays', 'reef lab', 'orders', 'journal', 'focus'.
evidence.C4: Mostly consistent cards and controls, but visible rough edges include truncated care text and a top toast that competes with the header.

fixes: Reduce crowding on the phone tank screen by grouping secondary tools or making the tank more dominant.
Fix text truncation and overflow in the care sheet and garden seed shelf so all labels and actions are fully visible.
Bring the field-guide visual language more consistently into fishing, garden, and journal screens so every screen feels as designed as the tank.

evidence.C1: Distinctive field-guide aesthetic with 'No. 01' plates, dotted ledger lines, glass-box tank with perspective side panes and depth haze; coherent warm cream + deep green palette, no purple. Fish illustrations remain simple vector shapes rather than richly detailed art.
evidence.C2: 'More to do' cards with arrow links to next loop step, numbered 'How the greenhouse works' 1-4 onboarding, clear tools row (Feed/Care/Scape/Residents/Shop/Photo/Watch/Share), well-grouped fishing controls (Flick/Classic, Phone motion/Vibration). Phone layout adapts cleanly with two-row tool grid.
evidence.C3: Care (nitrogen cycle, water test, glass wipe, heater/light schedule, trimming), Fishing (9 spots, flick cast, reel tension/drag, 5 baits, 5 lures, tournaments, 12 quests, 47 species, 5 rarities), Breeding with inherited colors, Aquascaping (16 plants, 8 hardscape, 3 substrates, 3 tank sizes, reef room), Greenhouse (cuttings, variegated sports, houseplants), Reef lab (frag, cross, named strains), Journal (fish dex, plants, strains, 18 milestones), Focus timer with box breathing, offline catch-up. Multiple interlocking loops clearly exceed a typical cozy aquarium.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, floating nav, and card styling across all screens; unobtrusive toast like 'Unlocked: Mountain stream, Mangrove inlet and 5 more'; empty states handled (empty trays show seed packet + trowel, unfound fish show silhouettes with hints). Spacing and component rhythm are uniform.

fixes: Increase visual detail and species-specific character in the 47 fish illustrations — current fish read as simple silhouettes and would benefit from more distinctive body shapes, fin detail, and color variation to match the field-guide ambition.

Add more visual variety to the tank scene — plants and hardscape look repetitive across screenshots; introduce more layered foreground/midground/background elements and richer substrate textures to make each tank feel unique.

Reduce text density in the desktop side column (water status, more to do, today's care, daily orders) — it competes with the tank as the hero; consider collapsible sections or a more scannable hierarchy so the tank art dominates the viewport.

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette with serif display type; tank drawn as a 'glass box' with 'depth haze', light rays and floor shadows; greenhouse has 'glazing bars over a warm sky'. But the Care sheet is plain grey tiles and fish are simple flat vectors, short of 'every screen feels designed'.
evidence.C2: Contextual hints on every screen ('Tap a fish to meet it, or tap the glass.', 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast'), a 1-4 'How the greenhouse works' strip, arrow links ('Harvest a ready tray above') and empty-state text ('Plant a seedling to start growing.'). Only gap: the 'Watch' tool's purpose (full-screen clock) must be guessed.
evidence.C3: Many loops present and interlocking: 'nitrogen cycle simulation', reel fight ('play line tension against fish strength'), tournaments, greenhouse with 'variegated sports', 'reef lab (frag, cross, named strains)', orders, '18 milestones', focus earning shells; 'Trimming gives cuttings' ties tank to garden. Breeding/scaping depth is asserted in the summary rather than visible, so not a clear 10.
evidence.C4: Consistent pills, cards and status dots ('fine') across tank, care, fishing, garden, journal, focus; toast 'Unlocked: Mountain stream...' is unobtrusive. Rough edge: Journal card misspells the Latin name as 'Paraqueirodon innesi' (standard: Paracheirodon).

fixes: Correct the misspelled species name in the Journal ('Paraqueirodon innesi' should be 'Paracheirodon innesi') and proofread all 47 species and strain names - credibility of the field-guide framing depends on it.
Lift the Care sheet to the same illustrated/field-guide standard as the other screens (its flat grey tiles are the least designed surface), strengthening C1 toward 'every screen feels designed'.
Add a sub-label or first-use hint to the 'Watch' tool (e.g. 'focus clock, keeps screen awake') - the eye icon plus 'Watch' reads as 'watch the fish', the one control a first-time player must guess.
